furnishing.body: This sits on top of whatever the layer covers.

examples.label: Photo tile with a caption bar over the image
examples.source:
<.component component_name="chelekom-image" site="Global" src="/images/card-1.jpg" alt="Sunlight across a kitchen counter" class="h-64 w-full object-cover" /> <.component component_name="chelekom-overlay" site="Global" id="overlay-photo-caption" color="dark" opacity="tinted" class="flex items-end">
Morning light, 6:40 a.m.
Shot on a 35 mm lens, straight out of camera.

examples.label: Report panel dimmed while the numbers load
examples.source:
<.component component_name="chelekom-h4" site="Global" size="medium" font_weight="font-semibold">Quarterly revenue <.component component_name="chelekom-p" site="Global" size="small" color="natural" class="mt-1">Measured against the same quarter last year.
<.component component_name="chelekom-overlay" site="Global" id="overlay-report-loading" opacity="heavily_tinted" backdrop="small" class="flex items-center justify-center gap-3"> <.component component_name="chelekom-spinner" site="Global" size="medium" color="natural" /> Reading twelve months of orders…
